a.xlink:title: FinancialInstitution 1 -- * ReusableFinancialInstrumentA ReusableFinancialInstrument has A FinancialInstitution. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one FinancialInstitution.A FinancialInstitution has some ReusableFinancialInstruments. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When a ReusableFinancialInstrument is created, its FinancialInstitution must be assigned. When a ReusableFinancialInstrument is deleted, its FinancialInstitution is not deleted and its list of ReusableFinancialInstruments is decreased. When a FinancialInstitution is deleted, its ReusableFinancialInstruments are not deleted. They are assigned to another FinancialInstitution.
